### Wayward Sheep - Truth For Life - July 25
Author: Truth For Life
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-july-25-2022.html
Passage: Hosea 5:15
Points:
- The Shepherd often employs trials and losses to herd wandering sheep back to the fold.
- Extended comfort and prosperity can breed spiritual arrogance and a false sense of security.
- Divine discipline strips away earthly confidences when they hinder genuine reliance on God.
- Genuinely grieving over backsliding during hardship is an encouraging sign of spiritual life.
- Believers should not despair under correction, but recognize the Father's loving hand and return to Him.
